description:
Change the pilgrim extras, private transfers or luggage transfer of
        an ALREADY QUOTED Camino de Santiago package, keeping the same hotels
        night by night: no new availability check, answers in a few seconds.
        Pass the COMPLETE new selection: `extras_ids` (from
        camino_extras_catalog; omit for the default credential + insurance),
        `traslados` (from camino_transfer_options; omit or [] for none) and
        `incluir_mochila`. Returns the same shape as quote_camino_package with
        the new single `total_paquete_eur` and a NEW `oferta_paquete_firmada`
        that replaces the previous one. Use it instead of quote_camino_package
        whenever only extras or transfers change. / Añade o quita extras y
        traslados del paquete ya cotizado sin volver a cotizar los hoteles.
        (es: actualizar_extras_paquete)
